text: What if friction disappeared for five seconds? Bad news. You're already falling.
Everyone walking hits the ground. Cars can't brake. Can't steer. They just slide. Straight ahead.
Every knot on Earth unties itself. Every phone shoots out of every hand. Eight billion screens. One sound.
Screws spin loose. Shelves drop. Your wardrobe is flat pack again.
Your clothes start coming apart. Thread only holds because of friction. Hold on to something. Oh wait. You can't.
Friction is back. Everything stops. Instantly.
Somewhere on the highway, a guy wearing half a hoodie is lying next to his car. Alive. And furious.
What should disappear next? Say it in the comments, or I pick something worse.
